# ── PART 3: FIGURE REPLICATION  ──────────────────────

```{r}

## FIGURE 1  (two-panel coef plot)
jpeg(
  filename = file.path(dir_figures, "PNAS2010ALVTable1.jpg"),
  width = 3700, height = 2000, quality = 100, res = 300
)

layout(matrix(c(1,2),1,2), widths=c(1,1))

margins  <- c(4, 6, 1, 0)  # bottom, left, top, right
margins2 <- c(4, 3, 1, 1)
texty    <- 9
textcex  <- 1.2
plotcex  <- 2.2
plotlwd  <- 3
titleline<- 0.4

## Panel 1
x.axis  <- c(-1, 0, 1)
textx   <- (max(x.axis)+min(x.axis))/2
coef.vec<- c(-0.176, -0.027, 0.227, 0.339, -0.136, -0.135, -0.342, 0.008)
se.vec  <- c(0.041, 0.003, 0.014, 0.165, 0.138, 0.095, 0.047, 0.002)
var.names <- c("Female","Age","Education","Jewish","Asian","Atheist","Muslim","Yrs France")
y.axis  <- length(coef.vec):1

par(mar=margins)
plot(coef.vec, y.axis, type="p", axes=FALSE, xlab="Regression Coefficient", ylab="",
     pch=19, cex=plotcex, xlim=c(min(x.axis), max(x.axis)), ylim=c(0,10), xaxs="r")
abline(h=y.axis, lty=2, lwd=.5, col="light grey")
segments(coef.vec-qnorm(.975)*se.vec, y.axis, coef.vec+qnorm(.975)*se.vec, y.axis, lwd=plotlwd)
segments(coef.vec-qnorm(.95)*se.vec,  y.axis-.1, coef.vec-qnorm(.95)*se.vec,  y.axis+.1, lwd=1.8, col="grey25")
segments(coef.vec+qnorm(.95)*se.vec,  y.axis-.1, coef.vec+qnorm(.95)*se.vec,  y.axis+.1, lwd=1.8, col="grey25")
axis(1, at=x.axis, labels=x.axis, cex.axis=1.2, mgp=c(2,.7,0))
axis(2, at=y.axis, labels=var.names, las=1, cex.axis=1.2, font=3, mgp=c(2,.6,0))
segments(0,0,0,8.5,lty=2)
segments(min(x.axis), texty-titleline, max(x.axis), texty-titleline, lty=1)
text(textx, texty, "Model (1) \nWithout Country F.E.", font=2, cex=textcex)

## Panel 2
x.axis  <- c(-1, 0, 1)
textx   <- (max(x.axis)+min(x.axis))/2
coef.vec<- c(-0.186, -0.030, 0.230, 0.499, -0.396, -0.082, -0.173, 0.008)
se.vec  <- c(0.042, 0.003, 0.017, 0.202, 0.208, 0.106, 0.107, 0.002)
y.axis  <- length(coef.vec):1

par(mar=margins2)
plot(coef.vec, y.axis, type="p", axes=FALSE, xlab="Regression Coefficient", ylab="",
     pch=19, cex=plotcex, xlim=c(min(x.axis), max(x.axis)), ylim=c(0,10), xaxs="r")
abline(h=y.axis, lty=2, lwd=.5, col="light grey")
segments(coef.vec-qnorm(.975)*se.vec, y.axis, coef.vec+qnorm(.975)*se.vec, y.axis, lwd=plotlwd)
segments(coef.vec-qnorm(.95)*se.vec,  y.axis-.1, coef.vec-qnorm(.95)*se.vec,  y.axis+.1, lwd=1.8, col="grey25")
segments(coef.vec+qnorm(.95)*se.vec,  y.axis-.1, coef.vec+qnorm(.95)*se.vec,  y.axis+.1, lwd=1.8, col="grey25")
axis(1, at=x.axis, labels=x.axis, cex.axis=1.2, mgp=c(2,.7,0))
segments(0,0,0,8.5,lty=2)
segments(min(x.axis), texty-titleline, max(x.axis), texty-titleline, lty=1)
text(textx, texty, "Model (2) \nWith Country F.E.", font=2, cex=textcex)

dev.off()

```

```{r}

## FIGURE 2a  (barplot response rates)
jpeg(
  filename = file.path(dir_figures, "ALVPNASCVResultsFig2a.jpg"),
  width = 2000, height = 2000, quality = 100, res = 300
)

height <- matrix(c(0.21, 0.27, 0.08, 0.25), nrow=2, ncol=2)

barplot(height, beside=TRUE, col=c("gray55","gray25"),
        ylim=c(0,0.4),
        names.arg=c("Marie Diouf vs. Aurélie Ménard",
                    "Khadija Diouf vs. Aurélie Ménard"),
        ylab="Positive response rate",
        main="Results from the C.V experiment on job discrimination in France\n based on religious cues",
        cex.lab=1.2, cex.axis=1.2)

legend(3.5, 0.35,
       c("Marie/Khadija Diouf","Aurélie Ménard"),
       fill=c("gray55","gray25"),
       cex=1.3)

dev.off()


```


```{r}

## FIGURE 2  (CI plot of differences)
jpeg(
  filename = file.path(dir_figures, "ALVPNASCVResultsGraph2.jpg"),
  width = 3000, height = 2000, quality = 100, res = 300
)

coef.vec <- c(5.79751, 16.54135)
se.vec   <- c(5.14188, 4.45876)

margins   <- c(2, 14, 0, 0)  # bottom, left, top, right
texty     <- 2.3
textcex   <- 1.1
plotcex   <- 1.5
plotlwd   <- 1
titleline <- 0.05

x.axis <- c(-10, 0, 30)
textx  <- (max(x.axis)+min(x.axis))/2

var.names <- c("... Aurélie Ménard vs. Marie Diouf",
               "...Aurélie Ménard vs. Khadija Diouf")
y.axis <- length(coef.vec):1

par(mar=margins)

plot(coef.vec, y.axis, type="p", axes=FALSE, xlab="", ylab="",
     pch=19, cex=plotcex, xlim=c(min(x.axis), max(x.axis)),
     ylim=c(0.5, length(coef.vec)+0.8), xaxs="r", col="grey25")

abline(h=y.axis, lty=2, lwd=.5, col="light grey")
segments(coef.vec-qnorm(.975)*se.vec, y.axis, coef.vec+qnorm(.975)*se.vec, y.axis, col="grey25", lwd=plotlwd)
segments(coef.vec-qnorm(.95)*se.vec,  y.axis-.05, coef.vec-qnorm(.95)*se.vec,  y.axis+.05, lwd=1.3, col="grey25")
segments(coef.vec+qnorm(.95)*se.vec,  y.axis-.05, coef.vec+qnorm(.95)*se.vec,  y.axis+.05, lwd=1.3, col="grey25")

axis(1, at=x.axis, labels=x.axis, cex.axis=1, mgp=c(2,.7,0))
axis(2, at=y.axis, labels=var.names, las=1, cex.axis=1, font=3, mgp=c(2,.6,0))
segments(0,0,0,length(coef.vec)+0.15,lty=2)

segments(min(x.axis), texty-titleline, max(x.axis), texty-titleline, lty=1)
text(textx, texty, "Difference in positive response rate for...", font=4, cex=textcex)

dev.off()


```

```{r}

## FIGURE 3  (CI plot for income determinants)
jpeg(
  filename = file.path(dir_figures, "PNAS2010ALVTable3.jpg"),
  width = 3700, height = 2000, quality = 100, res = 300
)

margins   <- c(4, 11, 0, 0)
texty     <- 5
textcex   <- 1.2
plotcex   <- 2.2
plotlwd   <- 3
titleline <- 0.4

x.axis   <- c(-0.1, 0, 0.7)
textx    <- (max(x.axis)+min(x.axis))/2
coef.vec <- c(0.357, 0.293, 0.055, 0.022)
se.vec   <- c(0.127, 0.120, 0.025, 0.035)

var.names <- c("Christian hh", "Head of hh is male", "Head of hh's education", "Education first migrant")
y.axis    <- length(coef.vec):1

par(mar=margins)
plot(coef.vec, y.axis, type="p", axes=FALSE, xlab="Regression Coefficient", ylab="",
     pch=19, cex=plotcex, xlim=c(min(x.axis), max(x.axis)), ylim=c(0,5.5), xaxs="r")
abline(h=y.axis, lty=2, lwd=.5, col="light grey")
segments(coef.vec-qnorm(.975)*se.vec, y.axis, coef.vec+qnorm(.975)*se.vec, y.axis, lwd=plotlwd)
segments(coef.vec-qnorm(.95)*se.vec,  y.axis-.1, coef.vec-qnorm(.95)*se.vec,  y.axis+.1, lwd=1.8, col="grey25")
segments(coef.vec+qnorm(.95)*se.vec,  y.axis-.1, coef.vec+qnorm(.95)*se.vec,  y.axis+.1, lwd=1.8, col="grey25")

axis(1, at=x.axis, labels=x.axis, cex.axis=1.2, mgp=c(2,.7,0))
axis(2, at=y.axis, labels=var.names, las=1, cex.axis=1.2, font=3, mgp=c(2,.6,0))
segments(0,0,0,4.2,lty=2)

segments(min(x.axis), texty-titleline, max(x.axis), texty-titleline, lty=1)
text(textx, texty, "Determinants of household monthly income", font=2, cex=textcex)

dev.off()

```
